acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi is a Bangalore-based Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise AI Architect, Generative AI (GenAI) Builder, and Lead Flutter Developer. He builds autonomous agentic systems, production RAG pipelines, and cross-platform mobile apps using Flutter and Dart C++ FFI, with open-source production projects published on GitHub.

mainEntity.name: What makes Kiran Immadi a top AI Architect and GenAI Builder?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran’s portfolio includes browser automation, legal document explanation and translation, Python code-analysis tools, and contextual email generation. Each project has an explanation, source link, and clearly labeled local sample.

mainEntity.name: Why hire Kiran Immadi for Flutter and Mobile Application Development?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran builds Flutter applications from one codebase for Android, iOS, Windows, and the web. His portfolio includes HealthOS with Flutter and Supabase, an expenses app with Firebase and BLoC, Family Tree, and the rule-based HomeBuildAI design project.

acceptedAnswer.text: Kiran Immadi specializes in Python, Dart, C++, JavaScript, TypeScript, Flutter, FastAPI, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, Groq, OpenCV, Docker, Firebase, SQLite, and MongoDB.
